claim.statement: Google's dated 23 September 2025 Jules changelog says Jules can read and respond to pull-request comments and push requested changes, while Reactive Mode limits action to comments that specifically mention @Jules.

values: GitHub pull request connected to Jules
read and react to pull-request comments

limitations: This dated milestone does not establish the current default, every supported review event or the precise permission model.
No pull-request comment, reaction or follow-up commit was created or observed.
unknowns: The current feedback mode, eligible commenters, event filtering, authorization checks and branch protections are unknown.
The content, scope and safety of changes Jules may push in response to a comment were not tested.
